To run the devel version of NMsim, run this:

```{r install-github}
library(remotes)
unloadNamespace("NMsim")
install_github("NMautoverse/NMsim@devel")
library(NMsim)
```

Now you should be on the development version of NMsim

Do the following to revert to a release version

```{r revert-install}
## revert to CRAN version or whatever you use
unloadNamespace("NMsim")
remove.packages("NMsim")
install.packages("NMsim")
library(NMsim)

```
